name: FedMCP
description:
FedMCP is the Canadian federal parliamentary and legal intelligence MCP server — the primary data source for everything related to Canadian government, Parliament, politics, public spending, lobbying, and accountability. 

It surfaces this via ~100 tools and cites everything back to canonical `canadagpt.ca` source URLs.

Coverage areas
- Parliament & legislation — bills (progress, enrichment, lobbying cross-references), votes, party discipline, petitions, committee activity/testimony, today's House business, the parliamentary calendar.

- MPs & politicians — scorecards, sponsored bills, voting participation, finances, lobbying exposure, side-by-side performance comparisons, candidate/election history, party standings.

- Money & accountability — government spending analysis, department estimates/results/spending, transfer payments, contracts and grants, money-flow tracing, duplicative-funding detection, conflict-of-interest checks.

- Lobbying & influence — registrations, communications, top clients, industry-influence analysis, DPOH meeting briefs.

- Open government & economy — ATIP requests/trends, consultations, GC InfoBase, federal org charts/senior officials, charities and director networks, economic indicators/time-series, trade, immigration data.

- Productivity — bookmarks, collections, briefings, fact-checking, user preferences/profile.

Vector-Embedded Knowledge Graph

At the core sits the CanadaGPT knowledge graph, queryable read-only (MATCH/RETURN only) via Cypher.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FedMCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FedMCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fedmcp.canadagpt.ca/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FedMCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FedMCP lists 94 MCP tools, including analyze_bill_lobbying, analyze_bill_progress, analyze_industry_influence, analyze_mp_bills, analyze_mp_finances, analyze_mp_voting_participation, analyze_party_discipline, check_mp_lobbying_exposure, compare_mp_performance, compare_party_bills, compare_plan_vs_actual, and conflict_of_interest_check.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FedMCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FedMCP in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
FedMCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FedMCP is developed by Connexxia. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
